title: On the Emerton-Gee stack of potentially semistable representations
summary: We first classify the potentially semistable Galois representations of a given tame inertial type using some variants of Breuil-Kisin modules. Then we construct some ``model" of such Breuil-Kisin modules. From here, we build a stack of our version of Breuil-Kisin modules, and show that it is isomorphic to the Emerton-Gee stack of potentially semistable representations.
